manifest.name: Wallet Watch (beta)
manifest.plain: Watches public Avalanche addresses you add, wallets or contracts, and tells you what changed, on its own while p0pc0rn is open; Juli also notes a wallet’s habits. Only public addresses go online, to Snowtrace, the public Avalanche explorer. It never gives advice and never touches a wallet.
manifest.description: Watches up to 5 public Avalanche addresses (wallets or contracts) with Snowtrace's free explorer and tells you what changed: AVAX and tokens in and out, a contract's busy spells and code changes. Juli describes a wallet's habits. Read only, no advice. Fits: watch a wallet, track a contract.
manifest.goal: Keep an eye on the addresses I watch and tell me what changed
manifest.author: p0pc0rn

addresses.desc: the addresses it starts with: keep the public example as it is; the person pastes their own in the app

address.desc: a public Avalanche C-Chain address: 0x and 40 letters or digits

kind.desc: wallet (an account) or contract (a smart contract)

interval_min.desc: minutes between its looks while p0pc0rn is open (only when the phone is idle): 30 is a good start, 15 at the least

notify.desc: what makes a notice in Juli's chat: changes (AVAX or tokens in or out of a wallet; a contract's code changes and busy spells), big (only AVAX moves of at least big_avax), all (everything), quiet (no notices)

big_avax.desc: how many AVAX make a move big (for notify: big)

notes_for_juli: title: 1-3 words for what is watched (Wallet Watch, Treasury Watch, Contract Watch). addresses: keep the starting list exactly as it is (the public WAVAX contract). Never write an address yourself, not even one from the request: one wrong letter would watch a stranger's wallet. The person pastes their own addresses in the app. interval_min: 30, or 15 when the request asks for fast (15 is the least), 60 when it asks for calm. notify: big when the request wants only big moves (then big_avax = the amount it names, else 100); all when it wants every transaction; quiet when it wants no notifications; else changes. Never put prices, balances, people's names or advice in slots. Example: 'tell me when the treasury moves more than 500 AVAX' -> title Treasury Watch, notify big, big_avax 500.
